import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, shutil, hashlib, stat
svc='jellyfin-pink.service'
root=pathlib.Path('/srv/projects/jellyfin-server')
project=pathlib.Path('/srv/projects/Vivoapk')
def run(args,timeout=15):
 try:
  p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
  return p.returncode,p.stdout.strip()
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: return 124,''
def prop(k):
 return run(['systemctl','show',svc,'-p',k,'--value'])[1]
services={s:run(['systemctl','is-active',s])[1] for s in (svc,'vivoapk-backend.service','nginx.service','postgresql.service')}
pid=int(prop('MainPID') or '0')
assert pid>0 and prop('User')=='jellyfinpink' and all(v=='active' for v in services.values())
# Read only the fixed component names, never command lines, environment, or secrets.
script="""import sys,pathlib,hashlib,json,os,stat
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
pid=sys.argv[2]
exe=pathlib.Path(os.readlink('/proc/'+pid+'/exe')).resolve()
paths=[exe.parent,root/'app',root/'bin',root/'server',pathlib.Path('/usr/lib/jellyfin/bin'),pathlib.Path('/usr/lib/jellyfin')]
names=('Jellyfin.Api.dll','Jellyfin.LiveTv.dll')
result={}
for name in names:
 found=[]
 for directory in dict.fromkeys(paths):
  p=directory/name
  if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and p.resolve().is_relative_to(directory.resolve()):
   found.append({'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'mode':oct(stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode))})
 result[name]=found
p=root/'data/plugins/VivoAPK Mega OTT Auth_0.1.0.0/Jellyfin.Plugin.VivoapkMegaAuth.dll'
result['plugin']={'exists':p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() else None}
result['private_network_namespace']=os.readlink('/proc/'+pid+'/ns/net')!=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net')
print(json.dumps(result))
"""
rc,out=run(['sudo','-n','-u','jellyfinpink','--','/usr/bin/python3','-c',script,str(root),str(pid)],20)
components=json.loads(out) if rc==0 else {'read_exit':rc}
source=project/'source'
backend_sha=run(['git','-C',str(source),'rev-parse','HEAD'])[1]
free=shutil.disk_usage(root).free
# Size estimate only: do not copy/inspect database content or create a backup.
rc,size=run(['sudo','-n','du','-s','-B1',str(root/'data'),str(root/'config')],25)
backup_bytes=sum(int(l.split()[0]) for l in size.splitlines()) if rc==0 else None
result={'scope':'read-only exact production release and rollback preflight; no provider requests, no service restarts or install','services_before':services,'backend_sha':backend_sha,'components':components,'disk_free_bytes':free,'estimated_data_config_backup_bytes':backup_bytes,'backup_space_check':backup_bytes is not None and free>backup_bytes*2+6*1024**3,'service_limits':{k:prop(k) for k in ('PrivateNetwork','MemoryMax','MemoryHigh','CPUQuotaPerSecUSec','TasksMax','NoNewPrivileges')},'current_ffmpeg':run(['/usr/bin/ffmpeg','-version'])[1].splitlines()[0],'lab_candidate':'d8e30ebe8cc8980a209188be448f2f118bfae2b2','production_activation_authorized_by_tests':False,'blockers':['production playback guard and authorized real source path not implemented','preserve network isolation until approved media path is proven','combined candidate regression result pending','upstream patched binaries and matching FFmpeg must be validated against installed runtime; rollback must include every changed component']}
result['services_after']={s:run(['systemctl','is-active',s])[1] for s in services}
assert result['services_after']==services
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
